question: May CodexBar import and forward the complete `longcat.chat` cookie jar for this provider, or must the implementation first identify and allowlist the minimum authentication cookies?
rationale: The branch intentionally uses all site cookies because LongCat's authentication cookie is undocumented; source inspection cannot determine the repository's acceptable credential scope.

options.title: Narrow Cookie Scope
options.body: Require live inspection to identify the minimum authentication cookies, update importer coverage, and provide redacted runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Accept Full Site Jar
options.body: Explicitly approve forwarding all `longcat.chat` cookies to the same-origin quota endpoints after reviewing redacted live proof and the isolated transport.

options.title: Pause The Provider
options.body: Keep the integration unmerged until LongCat documents a stable usage API or authentication-cookie contract.

recommendation.title: Narrow Cookie Scope
recommendation.body: Require live inspection to identify the minimum authentication cookies, update importer coverage, and provide redacted runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner has the clearest authority to accept a new provider and its credential-handling boundary.
